 FAQ 
 Questions Store Owners Ask Us

 Cannot find your answer? Our team replies fast and the first consultation is free.

 Ask Us Anything 
 

 
 How much do you charge for eCommerce web development solutions?
 There is no fixed cost. Pricing depends on the size, complexity and scope of your project. We analyze your requirements and give an estimate based on the hours needed. You can also buy blocks of time to use as you wish, and we refund unused time if a project finishes early.


 How long will it take to migrate my eCommerce store to a new platform?
 It depends on the size, complexity and scope of your store. Stores with many products, a large blog or media library, or complex functions take longer to move. We give you a clear timeline after reviewing your store.


 Do you develop custom themes for eCommerce sites?
 Yes. We can customize a market theme to match your brand or build a custom theme from the ground up, depending on your needs. Either way, the theme reflects your brand identity.


 Can you add custom features to my eCommerce store?
 Yes. We can integrate existing plugins and extensions, personalize them for your needs, or develop a custom solution from scratch.


 Can Virtina build an extension for my eCommerce business?
 Yes. We start with a discovery call to understand your pain points and goals, plan the strategy, and then develop a plugin with all the features you need.


 Can you customize the existing plugins on my store?
 Yes, within the limits of each plugin. From payment to shipping, our developers will tweak the plugin you use to fit your requirements.


 Does Virtina build mobile-friendly eCommerce websites?
 Yes. Every page we build is responsive and optimized for multiple devices, including themes we create from scratch, so shoppers get a smooth experience on mobile.


 Do you provide search engine optimization as an eCommerce solution?
 Yes. Our in-house SEO experts audit your store, check keywords, meta tags and sitemaps, optimize media, analyze links and more to improve your search rankings.


 Can your developers integrate ERP or CRM tools with my eCommerce website?
 Yes. We have done this for many stores. An ERP or CRM integration removes manual data entry and helps you manage customer relationships and operations more easily.


 Can you help me with advanced integrations for my online store?
 Yes. We handle inventory, sales, accounting, logistics and other integrations after analyzing your pain points and processes to choose the best fit for your business.


 What happens if my site does not work as promised after delivery?
 Every project goes through our QA team, and any issue found after delivery is covered by our 30-day warranty from the production release. Problems caused by servers, plugins, code changes or third-party providers are not covered.


 Do you provide training and support after completing a project?
 Yes. We provide knowledge transfer and complete training on the features we build, and our support team is available for any concern after launch.


 How do you communicate with your clients?
 A dedicated project manager keeps you updated and notifies you at every milestone. You can reach us by phone, email, instant messaging or whichever channel you prefer.


 Are you willing to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)?
 Yes. We respect confidentiality, share sensitive information only with the team on your project, and never disclose it to third parties.


 Do you provide eCommerce development services outside the United States?
 Yes. We have worked with companies from the United Kingdom to the United Arab Emirates, and our tools make it easy to coordinate with online stores worldwide.
